title: Florida House, District 117
what_it_does: Represents District 117 (Part of Miami-Dade) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Miguel Granda
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Miguel Granda is the Republican nominee challenging Rep. Kevin Chambliss in the Homestead-Florida City district. His campaign site lists financial relief, a strong economy, safe streets, quality schools and a fair share for South Dade as themes but does not detail specific policy positions, and he did not answer the Vote411 questionnaire.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

crime.summary: Granda's campaign site lists Safe Streets among his priorities and says he strongly believes in early intervention to keep kids on the right track, rather than framing public safety around tougher penalties.
crime.quote: All residents and neighborhoods must be safe. Miguel strongly believes in early intervention to keep kids on the right track.

sources.title: Issues - Miguel Granda for State Representative District 117

other_issues.title: Campaign themes
other_issues.summary: Granda says he will fight to lower the cost of living, create jobs in South Dade, keep neighborhoods safe through early intervention for youth, and improve schools.

sources.title: Miguel Granda campaign website: Issues

other_issues.title: Cost of living and jobs
other_issues.summary: Granda says Floridians are being squeezed and that he would work to lower the cost of living, and that he would push to create jobs close to home in South Dade.

sources.title: Issues - Miguel Granda for State Representative District 117

other_issues.title: Schools and career preparation
other_issues.summary: Granda says young people deserve an education that prepares them for careers and for vocational or higher education. He does not state a position on vouchers or school choice.

sources.title: Issues - Miguel Granda for State Representative District 117

other_issues.title: Approach to the job
other_issues.summary: Granda says no single person or party has all the answers and pledges to listen to constituents, and says he will work to make sure South Dade families are not neglected.

sources.title: Miguel Granda for State Representative District 117

candidates.name: Kevin Chambliss
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: State representative (since 2020); former community liaison for elected officials
candidates.background: Kevin Chambliss, 45, has represented the Homestead-area District 117 since 2020, defending a competitive seat in each election. Originally from Columbus, Mississippi, he holds a psychology degree from Jackson State University and previously worked as a campaign organizer and community liaison.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Chambliss voted against both 2026 property-tax proposals and says he hopes Amendment 3 fails, calling it the biggest state preemption attempt he has seen.
property_tax.quote: Hopefully Amendment 3 will fail. It is the biggest attempt at pre- emption the State has ever scene.
